title: Sale Price of an In-Home PAP Therapy Equipment Unit
content:
# Sale Price of an In-Home PAP Therapy Equipment Unit

**Sale terms.** A PAP Therapy Equipment unit bought outright is sold at the class's self-pay retail price, paid in full by the patient when the sale is booked; a unit already standing in the patient's home carries no delivery fee. The sale amount is stated in USD, rounded half up to the cent.

| Device class | Sale amount of the in-home unit |
|---|---|
| any class | the class's self-pay retail price |
| delivery fee | none, since the unit already stands in the home |

**Worked examples (hypothetical sales).**
- An Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) standing in the patient's home is sold at its self-pay retail price, 899.00, with no delivery fee: sale amount 899.00.
- A Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) in the home: 1850.00.

**Points of judgement.** *When is the price paid?* In full, by the patient, when the sale is booked. *Is a delivery fee added?* No; the unit is already in the home.
